verdict.rationale: Dagster documents an official Dagster+ MCP server that lets an AI session access deployment information and take actions, which directly fits an agent monitoring and acting on pipelines. The evidence does not specifically document checking sync or run status, diagnosing a failed run, or re-triggering a run through it. It is also scoped to Dagster+ rather than OSS. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCP/API tools for run-status queries, failure diagnosis (logs/errors), run re-execution, OSS availability, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can check sync status, diagnose a failed run, and re-trigger it through an API or MCP server

citations.quote: The Dagster+ MCP server allows you to access information and take actions in your Dagster+ deployment within an AI session.
Use Dagster's UI or APIs to run subsets of your dbt models, seeds, and snapshots.
